segments.t: Kostya volunteers to bring the champagne to room 202 himself so he can film Louis and Polina together as proof for Nastya. Meanwhile, Senya and Fedya finish feeding their model for the third time and eagerly await their promised reward.

Принесёшь прямо в номер, это отлично!
Запомни, у нас двести второй номер.
Большое спасибо тебе за помощь, Костя.
Саша, присмотри пока за моим баром.
Только смотри не делай как Луи!
Скажи, тебе было сегодня очень вкусно?
Молодцы, вы честно заслужили свою награду.

Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
Давай я сам принесу вам шампанское.

'Let me bring you the champagne myself.' Because Louis should let him bring Louis the champagne himself, Kostya treats the matter as settled. Starting with "davay" is the everyday Russian way to say "come on, let us do this".
Принесёшь прямо в номер, это отлично!

'You will bring it right to the room, that is great!' Because Kostya will bring it right to the room that is great, Louis does not bother softening the blow for Kostya. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
Запомни, у нас двести второй номер.
'Remember, we have room two hundred and two.' Here telling Kostya to remember they have room two hundred and two sets up the next turn in their exchange.
Большое спасибо тебе за помощь, Костя.

'Thank you very much for your help, Kostya.' Around the room and shift, Louis sets a calm, everyday tone with Kostya. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
Саша, присмотри пока за моим баром.
'Sasha, watch my bar for now.' Telling Louis to watch his bar for now is how Kostya lays out the situation for Louis.
Только смотри не делай как Луи!
'Just mind you do not do like Louis!' Kostya insists that just mind Louis does not do like Louis, leaving Louis no room to argue.
Скажи, тебе было сегодня очень вкусно?

'Tell us, was it very tasty for you today?' Wondering if tell them was it very tasty for Kostya today shows Senya caught off guard. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
Молодцы, вы честно заслужили свою награду.

'Well done, you honestly earned your reward.' Around the kitchen and shift, Senya sets a calm, everyday tone with Kostya. Notice how he sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.
Ну давай уже скорее награждай нас!
'Well come on and reward us quickly already!' Here coming on and reward them quickly already lets Senya's real feelings break through.
Мы честно кормили тебя два дня.

'We honestly fed you for two days.' Between the kitchen and the shift, Senya gives Kostya a quick, grounded response. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
Хорошо, ребята, закройте пока свои глаза.
'Alright, guys, close your eyes for now.' With the kitchen and conversation in play, Louis keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
Мы уже закрыли глаза и ждём.

'We have already closed our eyes and are waiting.' Saying that they have already closed their eyes and are waiting is how Senya sets the tone with Kostya. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
